content: Rohan Ahuja calls insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to inquire about reinstating his expired health policy with DCoders. Sunita confirms the policy expired on the 10th of the month and details the reinstatement quote of ₹25,000 (₹23,000 outstanding premium plus a ₹2,000 fee). Rohan opts to pay over the phone with his credit card and asks if the policy becomes active immediately upon payment, prompting Sunita to check the system.

action_items: Process the policy reinstatement payment of ₹25,000 over the phone
Confirm if the policy becomes active immediately after payment
